quiz.original_question: Why does the generator produce a ranked queue instead of a single hypothesis?
quiz.source_correct_answer: Because the runner needs depth so it can pop the next hypothesis when the first one fails
quiz.chinese_question: 生成器为什么输出有排名的队列，而不是单个假设？
quiz.chinese_explanation: 原A。后续失败时可取下一个，摊销预先生成开销；不是因为mock只返回列表、向量必须多输入或parser不能读单块。真实成本收益、失败归因与预算仍需测量。
quiz.main_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/06-规划.md
quiz.main_heading: 候选生成与调度的原测验核对

quiz.original_question: What does the temperature ramp accomplish on each pass?
quiz.source_correct_answer: It widens the sampling distribution so later drafts can land further from the seed
quiz.chinese_question: 每轮提高温度计划希望达到什么？
quiz.chinese_explanation: 原A。对真实采样希望扩大候选变化，给去重保留不同提议；不改变向量维度、parser容错或把seed乘三。该mock实际查桶，不保证温度升高就更正确或更新颖。
quiz.main_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/06-规划.md
quiz.main_heading: 候选生成与调度的原测验核对

quiz.original_question: When does the novelty filter reject a draft?
quiz.source_correct_answer: When its minimum cosine distance to any prior survivor falls below the novelty threshold
quiz.chinese_explanation: 原B。当它与此前接受者的最小余弦距离小于阈值；不是rank低或pass超过队列长度。源比较为 `<`，等阈接受；中文零向量和语义查新须另处理。
quiz.main_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/06-规划.md
quiz.main_heading: 候选生成与调度的原测验核对

quiz.original_question: Which three components combine in the rank score?
quiz.chinese_explanation: 原B。词面novelty、变量具体度specificity、可测性testability的加权和；不是延迟吞吐费用或温度seed轮次。字段数与基线字符串只是代理指标，且源N范围可到2，rank不能当置信概率。
quiz.main_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/06-规划.md
quiz.main_heading: 候选生成与调度的原测验核对

quiz.original_question: Why is the mock language model keyed on a temperature bucket rather than the raw float?
quiz.source_correct_answer: Because buckets make the schedule discrete so a small temperature change can pick a different scripted draft
quiz.chinese_question: mock为什么用温度桶而非原始浮点数作查表键？
quiz.chinese_explanation: 原A。把连续计划离散到有限脚本，跨桶时可换草稿；并非float不能hash、parser要求整数或embedding要求。邻近温度未跨桶仍同脚本，seed在单条库也不增加多样性。
quiz.main_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/06-规划.md
quiz.main_heading: 候选生成与调度的原测验核对

quiz.original_question: What happens if every draft from the mock model fails the parser?
quiz.source_correct_answer: The queue is empty and each pass logs a parse rejection so the failure mode is auditable
quiz.chinese_question: 全部mock草稿都解析失败会怎样？
quiz.chinese_explanation: 原B。返回空队列，每pass记录parse rejection，能解释这一失败；不会自动降低novelty阈值或改prompt重试。源仅捕获ParserError，其他异常不因此得到统一可审计终态。

quiz.main_heading: 候选生成与调度的原测验核对

quiz.original_question: Why does the critic score across five fixed dimensions instead of returning a freeform paragraph?
quiz.source_correct_answer: Because a fixed vector lets the harness detect per-dimension regressions across rounds
quiz.chinese_question: 为什么按五个固定维度评分，而不只返回自由文字段落？
quiz.chinese_explanation: 原D。向量提供可比较字段，便于发现逐维回退；自由文字也可核查，向量不自动有真值。源码只用mean判断平台，并未实现题意所暗示的全部回归门禁。
quiz.main_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/09-学习和适应.md
quiz.main_heading: 六道原测验的中文问题与解释

quiz.original_question: In what order does the loop check stop conditions at the end of a round?
quiz.chinese_question: 每轮结束按什么顺序检查停止条件？
quiz.chinese_explanation: 原D，target→plateau→budget。先确定五维达标，再检查低收益停止，最后预算；源码reviser的最后预算行为仍需修复。顺序使同轮多条件结果稳定，不使平台成为学术合格。
quiz.main_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/09-学习和适应.md
quiz.main_heading: 六道原测验的中文问题与解释

quiz.original_question: Why does plateau detection require two consecutive flat rounds rather than one?
quiz.source_correct_answer: Because deterministic scoring still has noise per round; one flat round is not enough signal
quiz.chinese_question: 为什么平台观察两段连续小变化，而非一段？
quiz.chinese_explanation: 原B的理由是避免单轮变化误停。必要更正：确定性评分在固定稿件上没有随机噪声，修改顺序／输入变化才影响分数；两段只能形成自设停止政策，不证明稿件真的再无改进。
quiz.main_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/09-学习和适应.md
quiz.main_heading: 六道原测验的中文问题与解释

quiz.original_question: What does the reviser receive as input each round?
quiz.source_correct_answer: The paper and the list of Suggestion records
quiz.chinese_explanation: 原D，paper与Suggestion记录列表。每条记录说明dimension、目标section与edit，reviser不直接收评分；接口可替换，但需实际diff、版本与no-op说明，不能借结构声称没有共享可变状态。
quiz.main_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/09-学习和适应.md
quiz.main_heading: 六道原测验的中文问题与解释

quiz.original_question: What does the trace contain for each round?
quiz.source_correct_answer: Round number, score vector, mean, suggestions applied, verdict
quiz.chinese_explanation: 原D，round、score vector、mean、suggestions_applied和verdict。它能支持分数轨迹与诊断；源码applied常是计划建议条数，未执行或no-op时仍可能误记，需改为真实回执并绑定稿件版本。
quiz.main_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/09-学习和适应.md
quiz.main_heading: 六道原测验的中文问题与解释

quiz.original_question: A critic that keeps emitting suggestions that never improve any score will produce which terminal verdict?
quiz.source_correct_answer: plateau or budget, because the harness will catch the lack of progress
quiz.chinese_question: critic持续提建议但所有评分都没有提高，会产生什么终态？
quiz.chinese_explanation: 原C，plateau或budget。有限循环会结束，但源plateau也叫converged，不能说它“从不会默默成功”；外部检查reason与五维目标。保留不合格状态和原因，再诊断critic、reviser、目标或证据问题，不能凭这一轨迹唯一归因。
quiz.main_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/09-学习和适应.md
quiz.main_heading: 六道原测验的中文问题与解释

quiz.original_question: Why does the scheduler use UCB scoring instead of always picking the current best branch?
quiz.source_correct_answer: Because greedy picks never explore; UCB balances exploitation with exploration
quiz.chinese_question: 为什么用UCB而非始终选择当前最高均值分支？
quiz.chinese_explanation: 原D。均值负责利用，少试分支的bonus提供探索；不因asyncio要求、队列无法排序或必然更快。是否有效取决于奖励与任务条件，不能宣称得到最有价值科研结果。
quiz.main_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/06-规划.md
quiz.main_heading: 候选生成与调度的原测验核对

quiz.original_question: What score does a branch with zero completed runs receive under UCB1?
quiz.source_correct_answer: Positive infinity, so untried branches are always picked first
quiz.chinese_question: 零次完成反馈的分支在源UCB中得到什么分数？
quiz.chinese_explanation: 原A，正无穷。它表达优先尝试，不是均值0或常数c；并发时还要pending预留，源码本身不保证每branch先一次再重复。
quiz.main_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/06-规划.md
quiz.main_heading: 候选生成与调度的原测验核对

quiz.original_question: How does the scheduler keep multiple slots busy?
quiz.source_correct_answer: It uses asyncio.create_task per dispatched hypothesis and awaits FIRST_COMPLETED on the in-flight set
quiz.chinese_question: 调度器怎样保持多个slot有工作？
quiz.chinese_explanation: 原A。每次派发create_task，对in-flight集合等待FIRST_COMPLETED，再释放slot继续派；不是线程池／multiprocessing，阻塞sleep会阻塞event loop。可让出执行与CPU并行应分开核验。
quiz.main_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/06-规划.md
quiz.main_heading: 候选生成与调度的原测验核对

quiz.original_question: When does the scheduler emit a paper.trigger for a branch?
quiz.source_correct_answer: On the first result whose branch mean meets or exceeds the paper threshold, and only once per branch
quiz.chinese_explanation: 原D。首次某branch均值至少达到阈值且其flag未置时发一次；不是每结果、到prune floor或仅最后。事件表示交给写作候选，后续退化与证据完整性仍要传递。
quiz.main_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/06-规划.md
quiz.main_heading: 候选生成与调度的原测验核对

quiz.original_question: What happens to a branch whose mean reward stays below the prune floor after the minimum-runs threshold?
quiz.source_correct_answer: The branch is marked pruned and remaining hypotheses on that branch are removed from the queue
quiz.chinese_question: 最低次数后均值低于prune floor的分支会怎样？
quiz.chinese_explanation: 原C。标pruned并移除队列中的该branch项；排序与剪枝分工不同。pending仍可能完成，源expander还可重塞，需正式协议防止意外重入。
quiz.main_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/06-规划.md
quiz.main_heading: 候选生成与调度的原测验核对

quiz.original_question: Which two budgets does the scheduler enforce as hard limits?
quiz.chinese_question: 原课称哪两种预算为hard limits？
quiz.chinese_explanation: 原D为max_experiments与max_seconds。必要更正：前者约束派发attempt数，后者只停新派发，wait/drain未有界，不能称源码已有hard wall cap；CPU／内存、队列深度和费用也不是这两参数已覆盖的资源。
